candidates.explanation: The size check uses the wrong comparison operator. It throws 413 when file.fileSize < maxFileSize, so small files are rejected and files at or above the limit pass. That is why a 200 KB png fails and a 20 MB file gets a signed URL. The check should be fileSize > maxFileSize.

candidates.explanation: The size check uses the wrong comparison operator. It throws 413 when file.fileSize < maxFileSize, so small files are rejected and files at or above the limit pass. That is why a 200 KB png fails and a 20 MB file gets a signed URL. The check should be fileSize > maxFileSize.

fix.description: Flip the comparison so it throws only when the file exceeds the limit: file.fileSize > (maxFileSize || 0). Also consider skipping the check when maxFileSize is unset, because the `|| 0` fallback would then reject every non-empty file.
